description: This is a Python source file for the behave testing framework, specifically the main entry point (__main__.py). It contains functions to run behave with a given configuration, handle command-line arguments, and print help information about languages, formatters, and runners.

methods.name: run_behave
methods.description: Runs the behave framework with a given configuration and optional runner class, handling various command-line options and exceptions.

methods.name: print_tags_help
methods.description: Prints help information about tag expressions and current tag expression.

methods.name: print_language_list
methods.description: Prints a list of supported languages for behave.

methods.name: print_language_help
methods.description: Prints help information for a specific language supported by behave.

methods.name: print_formatters
methods.description: Prints available formatters and their descriptions.

methods.name: print_runners
methods.description: Prints available test runners and their descriptions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for running behave as a script, handling command-line arguments.
